description: Mint a named Collection and return its content id. A collection carries no member list of its own — a mutable list would change the collection's own id every time something joined it, the same reason Lineage lives beside a model rather than inside it. Add members with sim_link(collectionID, "hasMember", memberID) — members must be stored entities — and read them back with sim_neighbors(collectionID, "hasMember") or sim_edges(collectionID). Content-addressed: creating a collection with a name already used returns the existing id, not a new sibling.
name: sim_create_collection
